in_marathi.name: Mahalakshmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahalakshmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahalakshmi is a revered goddess in Hinduism, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and abundance. She is often depicted holding a lotus or a golden pot filled with wealth and grains.

in_bengali.name: Mahalakshmi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of wealth and prosperity
